requirements.desc: Define the named freshness source policy `freshness-source`. It skips a directory before recursion when its basename is .git, .senti, node_modules, or vendor; it also skips a path matching specs/*/review-history, specs/*/review-evidence, or specs/*/tests/.raw. Every other source-root directory remains traversed and counted.
requirements.note: R1: excludes every named generated and runtime source boundary before the file budget

requirements.desc: Use that policy only for sourceRoot traversal. Traverse docs/ without source exclusions; return indeterminate if either scan reaches maxDepth 32, maxDirectoryEntries 10,000, maxFiles 10,000, or an unreadable non-excluded path.
requirements.note: R2: fails closed when a non-excluded source or documentation surface reaches a limit

requirements.desc: Add sourceScan and docsScan JSON details, each containing target, policy name, complete, and limits with kind, relativePath, and maximum. Keep result names and retain toText labels: fresh, stale with docs-build guidance, never-built with docs-build guidance, and indeterminate with limits.
requirements.note: R3: exposes source and documentation scan details without changing result labels

requirements.desc: Add unit tests in which .senti, node_modules, vendor, .git, and generated specs evidence contain more than maxFiles files but source and docs still return fresh or stale; separately prove that a limit in non-excluded source or docs returns indeterminate.
requirements.note: R4: ignores generated-only timestamp changes while retaining relevant traversal evidence

entries.reason: Confirmed TraversalLimit already supports unreadable and documented that it is shared by directory and stat failures, so both paths produce structured indeterminate evidence.
fix: documented that stat failures are converted into user-visible unreadable traversal limits.
entries.resolution: R2 requires a fail-closed indeterminate result; preserving the failure in FreshnessResult is explicit handling without corrupting command JSON or text output.

entries.reason: fix: recorded the project OOP value-model rule as the required no-overengineering exception for FreshnessScan.
entries.resolution: FreshnessScan owns invariant-enforced structured diagnostics and serialization required by the approved spec; removing it would violate the project coding rule.

entries.reason: Aligned text limit assertions with the structured first-rejected paths reported by the deterministic FileTreeWalker order.
FreshnessSourcePolicy now retains a work-root-relative source prefix so specs exclusions apply when scanning a nested source root.
The source docs predicate explicitly rejects the docs directory and its descendants before FileTreeWalker can recurse.
fix: restored the Flow-generated analysis artifact to its tracked base state.
entries.resolution: The generated analysis output is outside Issue #480 scope and is not part of the implementation; removing its incidental diff satisfies the scope check without changing product behavior.

entries.reason: fix: added explicit incomplete source and docs scan details to the never-built result.
entries.resolution: R3 now has the same serializable diagnostic shape for every verdict while preserving the never-built label and guidance.
